mapper.sql: tenant_id=#{owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value} AND session_id=#{owner.sessionRef.sessionId} AND target_kind=#{owner.target.kind} AND target_id=#{owner.target.id} AND end_user_id=#{owner.requireUser.value}
mapper.select: SELECT target_kind,target_id,session_id,end_user_id FROM public.agent_runtime_sessions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='CLOSED' AND (updated_epoch_second,updated_nano) <= (#{cutoffSecond},#{cutoffNano}) AND public.agent_runtime_session_owner_retirement_pending(tenant_id,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id) AND (target_kind,target_id,session_id) > (#{cursor.targetKind},#{cursor.targetId},#{cursor.sessionId}) ORDER BY target_kind,target_id,session_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT session.target_kind,session.target_id,session.session_id,session.end_user_id FROM public.agent_runtime_sessions session LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_session_history_retirements retirement ON retirement.tenant_id=session.tenant_id AND retirement.session_id=session.session_id AND retirement.target_kind=session.target_kind AND retirement.target_id=session.target_id WHERE session.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session.status='CLOSED' AND (session.updated_epoch_second,session.updated_nano) <= (#{cutoffSecond},#{cutoffNano}) AND (retirement.status IS NULL OR retirement.status<>'RETIRED' OR retirement.source_session_revision<>session.session_revision) AND (session.target_kind,session.target_id,session.session_id) > (#{cursor.targetKind},#{cursor.targetId},#{cursor.sessionId}) ORDER BY session.target_kind,session.target_id,session.session_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT target_kind,target_id,session_id,end_user_id,session_revision AS source_session_revision, updated_epoch_second AS closed_epoch_second,updated_nano AS closed_nano FROM public.agent_runtime_sessions WHERE AND status='CLOSED' AND (updated_epoch_second,updated_nano) <= (#{cutoffSecond},#{cutoffNano}) FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_session_history_retirements (tenant_id,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id,source_session_revision,closed_epoch_second,closed_nano) VALUES(#{owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value},#{owner.sessionRef.sessionId},#{owner.target.kind},#{owner.target.id}, #{owner.requireUser.value},#{revision},#{closedSecond},#{closedNano}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,target_kind,target_id,session_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH deleted AS (DELETE FROM public.agent_runtime_session_events WHERE AND event_id=#{eventId} AND session_sequence=#{sequence} RETURNING octet_length(payload_canonical_json) AS size_bytes) SELECT count(*) AS rows,COALESCE(sum(size_bytes),0)::bigint AS bytes FROM deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE public.agent_runtime_session_history_retirements SET scan_after_sequence=GREATEST(scan_after_sequence,#{after}), resume_after_sequence=#{resume},recheck_after_sequence=#{recheck,jdbcType=BIGINT}, retired_through_sequence=CASE WHEN #{rows}>0 THEN GREATEST(retired_through_sequence,#{after}) ELSE retired_through_sequence END, retired_event_count=retired_event_count+#{rows},retired_bytes=retired_bytes+#{bytes}, retired_reasoning_count=retired_reasoning_count+#{reasoning}, status=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN 'RETIRED' ELSE 'RETIRING' END,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND resume_after_sequence=#{expectedAfter}
mapper.sql: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_session_checkpoint_body_refs ref WHERE ref.tenant_id=body.tenant_id AND ref.run_id=body.run_id AND ref.body_hash=body.content_hash)
mapper.select: SELECT body.run_id, body.content_hash FROM public.agent_runtime_session_checkpoint_bodies body WHERE body.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (body.run_id,body.content_hash) > (#{cursor.runId},#{cursor.contentHash}) ORDER BY body.run_id, body.content_hash LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF body SKIP LOCKED

WITH deleted AS ( DELETE FROM public.agent_runtime_session_checkpoint_bodies body WHERE body.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (body.run_id, body.content_hash) IN (#{key.runId}, #{key.contentHash}) AND RETURNING octet_length(body.payload_data) AS size_bytes ) SELECT count(*) AS rows, COALESCE(sum(size_bytes),0)::bigint AS bytes FROM deleted

SELECT body.target_kind,body.target_id,body.session_id,body.content_hash FROM public.agent_runtime_session_event_bodies body WHERE body.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (body.target_kind,body.target_id,body.session_id,body.content_hash) > (#{cursor.targetKind},#{cursor.targetId},#{cursor.sessionId},#{cursor.contentHash}) ORDER BY body.target_kind,body.target_id,body.session_id,body.content_hash LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF body SKIP LOCKED

WITH deleted AS (DELETE FROM public.agent_runtime_session_event_bodies body WHERE body.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (body.target_kind,body.target_id,body.session_id,body.content_hash) IN
(#{key.targetKind},#{key.targetId},#{key.sessionId},#{key.contentHash}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_session_event_body_refs ref WHERE (ref.tenant_id,ref.target_kind,ref.target_id,ref.session_id,ref.content_hash) =(body.tenant_id,body.target_kind,body.target_id,body.session_id,body.content_hash)) RETURNING octet_length(body.canonical_content) AS size_bytes) SELECT count(*) AS rows,COALESCE(sum(size_bytes),0)::bigint AS bytes FROM deleted

SELECT FROM public.agent_runtime_session_events WHERE AND event_type='agent.runtime-diagnostic' AND event_version='1' AND payload_schema_id='skillforge.runtime.agent.runtime-diagnostic.v1' AND (occurred_at_epoch_second,occurred_at_nano)<(#{cutoffSecond},#{cutoffNano}) AND NOT public.agent_runtime_session_event_referenced(tenant_id,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id,event_id) ORDER BY session_sequence LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
